# OrbitWorks

> AI automation and IT services company in the USA. We help businesses scale
> through intelligent automation, cloud infrastructure, custom software and
> data-driven marketing — delivered by one team under a single strategy.

## About
OrbitWorks delivers AI automation, digital marketing, cloud infrastructure and
on-demand tech talent for US businesses. Offices in Baltimore (USA) and Toronto
(Canada). Contact: sales@orb-itworks.com · +1 443 260 9169

## Services
- AI Automation and Solutions: AI automation & GenAI, unified revenue dashboards, CRM setup and sales pipeline automation.
- Digital Marketing Growth: paid advertising management (Google, Meta, LinkedIn), SEO, content, email and WhatsApp marketing.
- IT and Cloud Solutions: cloud migrations and modernization, custom website development, mobile apps, software and product development, Power Platform and Dynamics 365, IT consulting and strategy, website maintenance.
- Staff Augmentation: on-demand IT talent and dedicated remote teams.
